section.title: Error Code 400 - Bad Request
section.p: The request contains invalid or missing data.
Resolution: Verify all required fields before sending the request.

section.title: Error Code 401 - Unauthorized
section.p: Resolution: Check that the API key is valid and correctly configured.

section.title: Error Code 404 - Not Found
section.p: The requested resource does not exist.
Resolution: Verify the endpoint URL and resource identifier.

section.title: Error Code 500 - Internal Server Error
section.p: Resolution: Retry the request later or contact support.
